# Product definition - current

## Current product outcome

An engineering reviewer can inspect a bounded process model and its assumptions
at a stated revision.

## Current workspace milestone

- Outcome: a reviewed process model for one bounded subsystem.
- Exit: semantic invariants and units are documented; a domain reviewer signs
  the review; known limitations are explicit.

## Non-goals

- Whole-plant simulation.
- Control integration.
- A presentation-specific data model.
